thesis: Taste combines real competence and shared cultural memory with unequal access and social classification.

ideas.statement: Education should transmit revisable attention rather than passwords; broadening aesthetic winners does not make dignity independent of the competition.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Expensive and minimalist forms can carry prestige without falsifying every pleasure; authenticity can constrain those whose lives outsiders admire.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Expensive and minimalist forms can carry prestige without falsifying every pleasure; authenticity can constrain those whose lives outsiders admire.

audit.notes: Direct active-LLM reading of all units; methodological and normative boundaries retained.
